name: destructive-disarmed-request-stays-pending
description: An armed destructive request is disarmed by another intent. The request is still waiting for an answer, but it is no longer armed.
reason: Disarming must not answer or drop the request: the agent is still waiting, and the person can still allow it with two fresh presses or deny it.
source: Epic #92 rule 'the armed state resets on any other intent'; ticket #116; DESIGN.md v2.2 §C (as amended by #116); AppState.handle
